video_goal: Demonstrate the step-by-step installation of Nicetown 100% Blackout Thermal curtains to achieve a fully darkened room.
required_subjects_and_props: Nicetown 100% Blackout Thermal curtains, metal curtain rod with removable finials, wall brackets (pre-installed), window frame.

outline_steps.visual_action: Hands pull the heavy Nicetown curtain fabric out of its clear plastic packaging, briefly exposing the brand label.
Hands flip the edge of the curtain fabric over to reveal the distinct, solid black thermal backing layer.
Hands reach up and unscrew the decorative finial (end cap) from a metal curtain rod that is already mounted above a brightly lit window.
Hands lift the curtain and push the first silver metal grommet onto the bare end of the curtain rod.
Hands fold the heavy fabric back and forth in an accordion style, sliding the next three grommets onto the rod to create deep, even pleats.
Hands push the gathered bundle of grommets further down the rod toward the center of the window to make room for the rest of the panel.
Hands position the final grommet on the outside of the wall bracket, trapping the fabric between the bracket and the rod's end to lock the outer edge in place.
Hands twist the decorative finial back onto the threaded end of the curtain rod until it is completely tight.
Hands pull and adjust the folds of the heavy thermal fabric from top to bottom so they hang evenly across the left side of the window.
Hands grab the leading edge of the Nicetown curtain and pull it firmly across the bright glass toward the center.
From inside the room, hands pull the two curtain panels together in the middle, instantly blocking out the sunlight and plunging the room into total darkness.
